checks.check: lodo_exports
checks.limitation: Leaving out the same original donor pairs describes sensitivity; these correlated fits are not independent biological replication.

checks.check: published_marker_observations
checks.limitation: Numerical exports are checked; agreement with published directions is recorded as an observation, not a forced pass. Same-dataset agreement is not a novel discovery or a clinical efficacy claim.

checks.check: session_and_summary
checks.limitation: Recorded versions and recomputed counters do not authenticate the runtime or script digest against Core receipts; root checks that separately.

checks.check: bootstrap_conditional_artifacts
checks.limitation: Independently verifies fitted-mean contrasts, source dispersions, first full simulated matrix digest and marker counts, marker Wald tails and type-7 summaries. Whole bootstrap BH cannot be independently recomputed from six-marker exports; only the first whole simulated matrix is exported. NB sample moments are descriptive observations, not distributional pass thresholds. No independent R RNG replay, dispersion/coefficient refitting or biological replication is claimed.

arithmetic.scope: Public-data domain artifact and arithmetic checks. Execution continuity, native dispatch count, upstream quantification, visual readability, and scientific generalization require their own evidence.

native.scope: Read-only observation using the same installed R packages as the native analysis; not an independent statistical oracle. No model is refitted.
